_help: Copy to config.json and edit. owner = GitHub user/org whose repos are checked (blank = the token's own account). skip_repos = never touched. report_only_repos = diagnosed and explained, never changed. hold_paths = paths it must not edit until a date. never_edit = any path containing one of these words is off-limits. never_rerun = workflows it will not re-start after a fix (anything that posts, deploys or spends). Emergency stop: create the OFF file or set DOCTOR_OFF=true.
